_README: Curation config for the Cell Browser all-tracks super hub (Redmine #37820). Edit this file (no Python needed) to extend the hub as new datasets arrive: add a collection's modality, a new assay keyword, a new assembly, a junk-dir name, etc. Re-run update_hub.sh afterward. Loaded by build_manifest.py (CFG) and build_stanzas.py.
_served_base_doc: Canonical served host written into manifest track URLs. To STAGE on cells-test, build with HUB_BASE_URL=https://cells-test.gi.ucsc.edu (env var, no manifest rebuild needed) -- build_stanzas/build_hub rewrite the host. Leave this at the production host.
_exclude_assemblies_doc: Assemblies to drop from the served hub (e.g. not present in the UCSC Genome Browser). build_hub.py omits them from genomes.txt and writes their trackDb/metadata to <hub>-disabled/<asm>/ on hive (kept, not web-accessible) instead of the served hub dir; publish skips their unpublished files. micMur3 (Mouse lemur, tabula-microcebus) has no GB assembly -- revisit later.
_exclude_dirs_bam_doc: Directory names holding raw per-cell/per-sample bam files; pruned from the dataset walk (bam is excluded by default anyway).
_exclude_dirs_wip_doc: Path segments marking work-in-progress/throwaway hubs. NOTE: hub_out is intentionally NOT here (it is cbHub's normal output dir).
_orig_source_dirs_doc: Submitter source dirs; unreferenced files here are dropped ONLY when the collection has a curated hub.
_desc_placeholder_doc: Lowercased markers identifying an unedited cbBuild desc template (dataset not ready for the hub).
_assembly_chr1_size_doc: chr1 size -> assembly, for bigWigInfo-based resolution. ADD A NEW ASSEMBLY HERE (and to genomes.txt) to support new organisms/builds.
_orphan_drop_doc: Regexes matched against the BASENAME of orphan (non-hub) files, which are then dropped. Only orphans are tested, so a hub-backed file of the same name is safe. (1) .introns.bb are intermediates -- the hubs publish the matching .junctions.bb. (2) barChart.bb without a hub stanza cannot be published: a bigBarChart needs barChartBars (the category labels) plus barChartMatrixUrl/SampleUrl, and those exist only in the stanza, so an orphan bar chart has no way to render. The three real bar charts (cortex-dev, healthy-human-skin, mouse-dev-brain) are hub-backed and unaffected. Regenerate a dropped one properly if it is wanted. (3) A bare temp.bb / temp.bw is scratch: cortex-atac/hub/temp.bb was 10 chr1 peaks from 2020 with no original_track_name, and it was surfacing as a track called 'temp'. Note exclude_dirs_wip already covers a temp/ DIRECTORY; this covers the filename.
_modality_rules_doc: Ordered [regex, label] pairs (case-insensitive) tested against a track's path + curated labels + filename. First match wins. Add new assays here.
_modality_multiome_is_doc: In the faceted composite (signal + peaks only), a track whose modality resolves to 'multiome' is the ATAC (accessibility) readout of the multiome assay -- the RNA half isn't a browser signal track. Verified per dataset: multiomic-human-heart (ATAC_fragment_files), mouse-lvcp-multiome (scMultiome/atac/), olg-dyn-eae/olg-eae-ms (ArchR ATAC bigWigs). So 'multiome' is resolved to this value.
_collection_modality_doc: Per-collection modality fallback, applied ONLY when modality_rules find nothing. For single-modality studies whose assay isn't in any path/label. Leave multi-modal collections out (let the rules label each track).
_celltype_expansions_doc: Per-dataset acronym -> full cell-type name (case-insensitive key match), for acronyms the longLabel does NOT spell out. Sourced from each dataset's paper (stashed as /hive/data/inside/cells/datasets/<ds>/paper.md). Context-aware by dataset (retina MG = Muller glia; brain MG/MGL = Microglia; mouse-epi RGC = radial glia, not retinal ganglion). Applied only when the label has no '<ACR> - <expansion>' form.
_tissue_from_path_doc: Collections whose bigWigs are organized by tissue in the path (the segment right after the named marker dir is the per-track tissue), e.g. fetal-chromatin-atlas/hub/bigWigs/<tissue>/<file>. Overrides the collection-level body_parts tissue for these. (human-enhancer-atlas is intentionally NOT here: its bigWigs pool each cell type across all tissues, so 'multiple' is correct for most of them; the tissue-restricted ones are handled by celltype_tissue below.)
_celltype_tissue_doc: Per-dataset cell-type -> tissue override, applied AFTER track_tissue by matching the (case/plural-normalized) Cell type. For whole-body atlases labeled 'multiple' (human-enhancer-atlas: one bigWig per cell type pooled across tissues), a minority of cell types are tissue-restricted -- they occur in only one organ's samples in the atlas's own metadata (meta.fixed.tsv). Those get the specific tissue; the pan-tissue majority (fibroblast, macrophage, endothelial, T cell, ...) stay 'multiple'. Derived by counting distinct tissues per cell type in the meta; keys spelled as the collapsed Cell type name.
_lifestage_from_path_doc: Per-dataset [segment-regex, life-stage] rules. For each track, path segments are tested against the dataset's rules in order; first match sets the Life stage facet. Listed only for datasets with an unambiguous stage as a standalone path segment (human-enhancer adult/fetal dirs, multiomic-human-heart fetal/postnatal, brain-spatial-omics e13/p21/p22 dirs). Datasets whose age is embedded in filenames are handled by collection_lifestage instead.
_collection_lifestage_doc: Whole-collection life stage, used when the stage isn't a clean path segment (fallback after lifestage_from_path). Determined per dataset from desc.conf + stashed papers. Uniform single-stage studies: fetal-chromatin/cortex-atac/ssd-prenatal (Fetal), mouse-motor (Embryonic, E9-E13), mouse-kidney (Postnatal, P0-P56), mouse-epi-juv + mouse-brain-cutandtag (Juvenile, P15-P25/P19), retina/neuro-degen/olg-eae-ms/olg-dyn-eae (Adult). 'Multiple' = each track pools cells across >1 stage: cardiogenesis (PCW6/8 embryonic + PCW19 fetal), brainvar (fetal->postnatal DLPFC), mouse-lvcp (P11 postnatal + P60 adult), multiomic-human-heart (the hub/celltype tracks pool fetal+postnatal; disease/fetal & disease/postnatal[-diseased] still get Fetal/Postnatal from the path).
_celltype_lifestage_prefixes_doc: A leading one of these words is stripped from a Cell type (e.g. human-enhancer 'Fetal Excitatory Neuron' -> 'Excitatory Neuron') so fetal/adult versions of the same cell type collapse into one facet value, distinguished by the Life stage facet instead.
_celltype_rollup_regex_doc: Applied in rollup_celltype after the overrides: if a Cell type matches, the WHOLE value becomes the replacement. Folds fetal-chromatin marker-gene clusters ('Igfbp1 dkk1 positive', 'Skor2 npsr1 positive', ...) and unannotated clusters ('Cerebrum unknown.3', 'Kidney unknown.7', 'Unknown neurons', cortex-dev 'Unknown N') into a single 'Unannotated' bucket. Fine label kept in _name.
_celltype_rollup_doc: Collapse-in-place rollup of the Cell type facet to a higher level (the full fine label stays in the track Name/_name). rollup_celltype(): strip a trailing parenthetical qualifier ('Fibroblast (General)'->'Fibroblast', 'Smooth muscle (Colon)'->'Smooth muscle') and a trailing subtype number ('T lymphocyte 1 (CD4+)'->'T lymphocyte', 'Diffuse bipolar 3a'->'Diffuse bipolar'), then apply celltype_rollup_overrides. celltype_rollup_protect_regex guards names where the trailing number is part of the identity, not a subtype index (Alveolar type 1/2 = AT1/AT2, kept distinct). Overrides fix merges the rules miss (Endothelial<->Endothelial cell) and re-singularize plurals. Applied AFTER the tissue override so celltype_tissue still matches the fine name. Conservative first pass; extend overrides to collapse further (e.g. named retina bipolar or cortex-dev regional subtypes) if wanted.
_celltype_expansions_global_doc: Universal (all-dataset) cell-type acronym/variant -> canonical name, matched case-insensitively on the whole cleaned label. For acronyms that mean the same thing everywhere (OPC = oligodendrocyte precursor cell in every CNS dataset here) and to fold naming variants (Oligodendrocyte Precursor/Progenitor) into one facet value. Applied after the per-dataset celltype_expansions.
_id_noise_subcollections_doc: Generic container subcollection segments dropped from the (shortened) primaryKey/track id, e.g. <coll>__hub__<name> -> <coll>__<name>. Meaningful subdataset names (hrca, eae_atac, ...) are kept.
_id_strip_suffix_regexes_doc: Regexes stripped from the end of the track-name part of the id to drop verbose pipeline suffixes (e.g. ArchR _tilesize_100_normMethod_..._archr). Collisions from shortening are de-duped automatically.

expression_composite.longLabel: RNA-seq expression coverage from UCSC Cell Browser datasets

histone_composite.longLabel: Histone modification and CUT&Tag tracks from UCSC Cell Browser datasets

_histone_composite_doc: A SECOND faceted composite (parallel to the main signal+peaks one) that holds every track whose modality is a histone mark / CUT&Tag / ChIP-input, so histone data lives in one place instead of being mixed with ATAC. Same facet metadata shape as the main composite, written to <asm>.histone.metadata.tsv. Set to null to fold histone marks back into the main composite.

ccre_composite.longLabel: Candidate cis-regulatory elements (cCREs) from UCSC Cell Browser datasets

_ccre_composite_doc: A faceted composite (parallel to the signal+peaks and histone ones) holding candidate cis-regulatory element tracks, kept separate from the raw ATAC peaks the way ENCODE cCREs are their own track. A bigBed is classified as a cCRE when its label matches 'ccre' (build_stanzas CCRE_RE); extra_collections roots set datatype:cCRE to force that label. Metadata written to <asm>.ccre.metadata.tsv. Set to null to fold cCREs back in with peaks.
_collection_celltype_colors_doc: Per-collection cell-type crosswalk. Each value is a TSV (relative to the build dir) with columns: <hub cellType> <TAB> <canonical cellType> <TAB> <R,G,B> [<TAB> tissue <TAB> life_stage <TAB> condition]. build_stanzas rewrites the Cell_type facet value to the canonical (2nd) column -- harmonizing split labels, e.g. SEA-AD's MTG 'Astro' vs PFC 'Astrocyte' both -> 'Astrocyte' -- and colors each track with the 3rd column, so the genome-browser tracks share cell-type colors across datasets/assemblies (colored by broad cell class, colorblind-conscious palette; see build_celltype_crosswalks.py). The optional 4th-6th columns override the Tissue/Life_stage/Condition facet for that track (used e.g. to fill the CATLAS aging atlas's per-track tissue and age). Codes are paper-curated (Li 2021, Zhang 2022, Zhu 2021, Allen taxonomy); see celltype-crosswalks/.
_collection_cells_dataset_doc: Override the Cell Browser dataset slug used for a collection's Dataset facet link (subtrackUrls turns it into https://cells.ucsc.edu/?ds=<slug>). Only needed where the collection name is not itself a served slug: sea-ad-brain-atac is served as the cohort dataset of the sea-ad-mtg collection, so linking it by collection name returns 404. Verify a slug with curl -sI https://cells.ucsc.edu/<slug>/dataset.json (the ?ds= page always returns 200 -- it is the single-page-app shell -- so it cannot be used to test).
_track_type_short_doc: Short name for each kind of track, used when a track holds data from exactly one dataset: its label becomes '<short name> - <dataset shortLabel>', e.g. 'Splice Junc - Cortex development'. Keyed on the track-name SUFFIX after cellBrowser<Asm> ('' is the main signal-and-peaks composite, 'Bar' the standalone bar charts), NOT on the track's prose shortLabel -- keying it on the label meant renaming a composite here silently dropped it back to the long name. Multi-dataset tracks ignore this and keep their generic label. Add an entry when a new composite kind appears; build_stanzas warns if a suffix is missing.
_expression_composite_doc: Faceted-bound signal/peaks tracks whose modality is one of 'modalities' are RNA expression COVERAGE (not chromatin accessibility/histone), so they're routed OUT of the 'signal & peaks' faceted composite into their own plain compositeTrack cellBrowser<Asm><suffix> under the superTrack. Currently only cortex-dev RNA coverage; future RNA-coverage datasets join automatically. Routed by modality so a dataset's annotations/barCharts stay in their own sections.

mouse-motor-atac.longLabel: Motor neuron ATAC signal by sample (age, replicate)

brain-spatial-omics.longLabel: Brain spatial multi-omics signal by cluster, assay and age

_separate_collections_doc: Whole collections whose tracks are NOT per-cell-type signal (bulk sorted-population ChIP, sample/replicate pseudobulk, or unnamed cluster x assay x age). Every track in these collections is routed OUT of the faceted composite into its own compositeTrack cellBrowser<Asm><suffix> under the per-assembly superTrack (all bigWig). Takes priority over the per-track type routing.
_collection_condition_doc: Condition facet, per collection: {default, map?}. 'map' keys are condition tokens (lowercase) matched as a coded shortLabel suffix (X_Ctr) or as a word in short/long/filename; the value is the facet Condition. The matched token is also stripped from the Cell type (leading word 'Control astrocyte' -> 'Astrocyte', or trailing code 'COP_Ctrl' -> 'COP'), merging condition variants of one cell type. 'default' applies when no token matches. Collections not listed -> 'unknown'. Healthy defaults confirmed per dataset from desc.conf/papers (all faceted collections are normal/reference atlases; disease terms in those studies are GWAS risk-loci mapped onto healthy tissue, not diseased samples). Disease contrasts: multiomic-human-heart (Healthy vs Diseased); olg-eae-ms and olg-dyn-eae-multiome are EAE studies (experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, the standard mouse model of multiple sclerosis) -- Control arm mapped to Healthy, EAE (with olg-dyn timepoints early/peak/late) is the disease.
_datatype_labels_doc: Friendly display labels for the Data type facet values (the internal 'signal'/'peaks'/'annotation' are kept for routing; only the metadata cell value is relabeled). Generic on purpose: the faceted composite mixes ATAC accessibility signal with histone-mark (CUT&Tag) coverage, so 'read coverage'/'enriched regions' read correctly alongside the Modality facet (which supplies the assay). NOTE: this is NOT the ENCODE-style 'dataTypes' composite setting (that selector is for a sample x dataType subtrack layout; this hub is one-row-per-track).
_celltype_leading_strip_regex_doc: A leading assay/histone-mark or neuropathology token is stripped from a Cell type. mouse-epi-juv-brain labels its clusters 'H3K27ac EXC1' / 'H3K27me3 uni' and brain-spatial-omics similar -- the mark is redundant with the Modality facet (and is now carried in the track label by track_variant), and leaving it on the front stopped 59 cell types matching the class table. Stripped early in raw_celltype so the remaining cluster code (EXC1, INH1, AST NT, ...) then hits the per-dataset expansion. 'H3K27ac EXC1' -> 'EXC1' -> 'Excitatory neurons 1' -> rollup 'Excitatory neuron'. Note the separator class is [\s_]+, not \s+: this strip runs in raw_celltype before underscores are turned into spaces, so the underscore form ('H3K27me3_uni_5') is what actually arrives here.
_celltype_trailing_strip_regex_doc: Stripped from the end of a Cell type before expansion/normalization. Removes the fetal-chromatin annotation-confidence marker ' unsure' ('Megakaryocytes unsure' -> 'Megakaryocytes').

separate_signal_composites.longLabel: Cortex ATAC miRNA-binding read coverage by age and region

_separate_signal_composites_doc: bigWig tracks that are NOT per-cell-type signal and shouldn't sit in the faceted composite. Each entry pulls tracks whose shortLabel/longLabel/filename matches match_regex into their own compositeTrack (cellBrowser<Asm><suffix>) under the per-assembly superTrack, out of the facets. cortex-atac 'miRNA-binding for age and region: GW.../adult' pseudobulk-by-sample tracks (their own composite in the source hub) -> the MiRNA composite.
_celltype_ignore_label_regex_doc: If a track's curated longLabel matches this, its cellType is set to unknown -- the track isn't per-cell-type. Catches cortex-atac 'miRNA-binding for age and region: GW20PFC/adult/...' sample tracks (gestational-week + brain-region labels, not cell types).
_celltype_strip_suffix_regex_doc: Peak-method and product suffixes tacked onto cell-type labels (cortex-atac: 'Microglia_MACSpeaks', 'IPC_Enhancerpeaks'; the cCRE sets: 'Astrocyte 1 cCREs') -> stripped to the base cell type before acronym expansion. The dataType facet already separates signal vs peaks vs cCRE, so carrying it in the cell type only split the Cell_class lookup: 220 cCRE cell types were landing in Cell_class 'unknown' purely because of the suffix. The separator class includes '.' and the list includes 'inter': the Human Enhancer Atlas interaction files are named <CellType>.inter.bb with no hub stanza, so the cell type was coming out as 'Acinar.inter'.
_celltype_species_words_doc: Species/sample words that leak into the terminal '- X' segment of some labels (retina 'AC Peaks - Both'). When the cleaned Cell type equals one of these, fall back to the leading token of the label (the real cell-class acronym, e.g. AC -> Amacrine cell).
_celltype_doc: Heuristics for deriving cellType from curated child labels. aggregate_* assigns 'all clusters' to expression barCharts and merged peak tracks (no single cell type).
_dataset_labels_doc: Override for dataset_label(collection) when a collection has no cellbrowser.conf on disk (e.g. the extra_collections track dumps). Checked before the cellbrowser.conf lookup.
_extra_collections_doc: Track-only sources not laid out as Cell Browser datasets. build_manifest scans each root for big* files and emits manifest rows with the given collection/assembly, excluded=0 (bypasses the desc-readiness gate). type: bigWig|bigBed|bigInteract. Paths are relative to the datasets root. human-enhancer-atlas re-uses the existing served collection so the cCRE bigBeds join it.
